perspectives.name: discovery-weak-signals

factors.name: safetyComponentManufacturingReadiness
factors.basis: NuScale and MillenniTEK announced successful fabrication of first-of-a-kind boron-oxide pellets for NuScale's passive emergency core cooling system, adding physical manufacturing evidence distinct from prior engineering-software evidence.

risks: First-of-a-kind component fabrication is a supply-chain maturation milestone, not evidence that a complete commercial plant has been manufactured or financed.
unknowns: Production yield, unit cost, scale-up cadence and first-customer installation timing were not disclosed.

perspectives.name: expectations-execution

factors.name: componentExecution
factors.basis: The September 1 milestone moves a specialized safety component from design/process development into demonstrated fabrication with an advanced nuclear materials manufacturer.

risks: Commercial deployment still depends on broader module manufacturing, customer financing, site work, licensing and construction execution.
unknowns: Whether this component is on the critical path for first deployment and when serial production begins remain unknown.

facts: NuScale and MillenniTEK successfully fabricated first-of-a-kind boron-oxide pellets for NuScale's passive emergency core cooling system.
NuScale characterized the milestone as progress in specialized component and manufacturing-process readiness for deployment.

result: Materially different primary manufacturing evidence packaged for Alpha; no numeric underwriting or final causal judgment created.
